name: Team Topologies Modeler
description: Open .tt and .ttm.json files as Team Topologies diagrams: model teams, their interactions and the flow of change, and see an agent's changes to the file as they happen.

cover.alt: Miragon Modeler for Team Topologies: Team Topologies diagrams from plain .tt files, edited by you and your agents.

screenshots.alt: A team topology of a ride-hailing company with stream-aligned teams, an enabling team, a complicated-subsystem team and a platform along the flow of change
screenshots.caption: Team types and the flow of change

screenshots.alt: A team topology of an online shop with collaboration, facilitating and X-as-a-Service interactions between its teams
screenshots.caption: Interaction modes between teams
